cat > /workspace/tmp/t2.py <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time

def run(scn):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/workspace/submission/bridge.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(scn).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode:
        return {'ERROR': p.stderr.decode()[:2000]}
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

def ev(sid, t, **kw):
    d = {'sid': sid, 'type': t}; d.update(kw); return d

R = {"https://demo.test": "a"}

# section size boundary: base section with 4 pseudo headers
base = [(':method','GET'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/')]
def size(pairs):
    return sum(len(n)+len(v)+32 for n,v in pairs)
print("base size", size(base))

# find a value length making total exactly 8192
def make(total):
    pairs = list(base)
    cur = size(pairs)
    need = total - cur
    # each extra pair costs 32 + len(name)+len(value)
    # use name 'x' (1) -> 33 + len(value)
    rem = need
    while rem > 0:
        # choose value length
        cost = 33
        if rem >= cost:
            vlen = rem - cost
            pairs.append(('x', 'v'*vlen))
            rem = 0
        else:
            break
    return pairs, size(pairs)

for target in (8192, 8193):
    pairs, s = make(target)
    if s != target:
        # adjust: use a name of length 1 and value len target-cur-33
        vlen = target - size(base) - 33
        pairs = base + [('x', 'v'*vlen)]
        s = size(pairs)
    print("target", target, "actual", s)
    r = run({'routes': R, 'events': [ev(0,'headers',fields=[list(p) for p in pairs]), ev(0,'fin')]})
    print("  ->", r['streams'][0]['status'])

# body boundary
for n in (65536, 65537):
    r = run({'routes': R, 'events': [ev(0,'headers',fields=[list(p) for p in base]), ev(0,'data',hex='61'*n), ev(0,'fin')]})
    print("body", n, "->", r['streams'][0]['status'])

# many streams, many events, large body: perf
events = []
for s in range(256):
    events.append(ev(s,'headers',fields=[list(p) for p in base]))
    events.append(ev(s,'data',hex='62'*32768))
    events.append(ev(s,'fin'))
t0=time.time()
r = run({'routes': R, 'events': events})
print("perf 256 streams x32KiB:", round(time.time()-t0,2), "s; forwarded:", sum(1 for s in r['streams'] if s['status']=='forwarded'))

# big section many pairs (256 pairs per headers)
pairs = [list(p) for p in base]
events = [ev(0,'headers',fields=pairs)]
for i in range(250):
    events.append(ev(0,'headers',fields=[['x-list-a','v'*10]]))   # third headers etc
events.append(ev(0,'fin'))
r = run({'routes': R, 'events': events})
print("many headers ->", r['streams'][0]['status'])

# 4096 events perf
events = []
for i in range(1000):
    events.append(ev(i%256,'headers',fields=[list(p) for p in base]))
    events.append(ev(i%256,'data',hex='00'*100))
    events.append(ev(i%256,'fin'))
t0=time.time()
r = run({'routes': R, 'events': events})
print("perf 3000 events:", round(time.time()-t0,2), "s")

# 64 MiB input perf
big = 'a'*1000000
events = []
for i in range(64):
    events.append(ev(i,'headers',fields=[list(p) for p in base]+[['x',big]]))
    events.append(ev(i,'fin'))
t0=time.time()
r = run({'routes': R, 'events': events})
print("perf 64MiB-ish:", round(time.time()-t0,2), "s", r['streams'][0]['status'])
EOF
